editedExercise.name: Arm Pulses

instructions.description: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart. Keep your knees slightly soft, your core gently engaged, and your spine in a neutral position.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are approximately at shoulder height. Keep your elbows slightly relaxed rather than fully locked, and keep your shoulders down and away from your ears.
Pulse your arms up and down in a small, controlled range of motion. Keep the movement quick and consistent while keeping your torso, hips, and legs as still as possible.
Continue for the desired duration while breathing naturally. Maintain good posture and avoid using momentum or shrugging your shoulders.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.
Record the time during this exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Rotate arms clockwise and counterclockwise for dynamic stretch.

commentsNotes: Keep your core gently engaged to stabilize your torso.
